**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Read Aloud
- **Playback controls** — while text is being read aloud, the small pill at the bottom of the screen now stays on screen as a transport: **✕** stops, **⏸ / ▶** pauses and resumes, and a speed button steps through 0.75×–2× live without restarting playback. The speed you pick is kept as the new default under Settings → Read Aloud. Pressing the Read Aloud shortcut again still stops.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.14...v8.15
